profile_anchor.name: Mark Khaw
target_roles: Data & AI Pre-sales / Finance Presales Solution Advisor
profile_anchor.positioning: Early-career cloud and AI solution architect with Alibaba Cloud and Huawei Cloud pre-sales experience, Intel finance data analytics exposure across Snowflake, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, SAP/SAP HANA, and bilingual English/Mandarin customer-facing coverage across SEA.
strongest_signals: Customer discovery, demos, POC support, and RFP/RFI support
Finance data analytics and BI stakeholder bridge at Intel
Data platform exposure: Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, SAP/SAP HANA
screening_rules: Prioritize IC, graduate, junior, associate, and 1-3 year roles.
Do not auto-apply to Manager, Senior Manager, Principal, Staff, Director, or Head roles.
Do not auto-apply where the listing clearly requires current Singapore work authorization without sponsorship unless Mark confirms eligibility.
Do not over-position as a deep hands-on software engineer; keep coding-heavy FDE roles in research first.

summary.top_pick: Red Hat - Junior Solution Architect, OpenShift
summary.focus: Early-career / associate / around 3 years Singapore IC roles

opportunities.title: Junior Solution Architect - OpenShift
opportunities.freshness: Official listing checked 2026-06-02; posted recently according to Red Hat Workday.
why_match: Exact level match: Junior Solution Architect with a 12-month FASTER development program, not manager-level.
Customer discovery, technical presentations, demonstrations, workshops, pilot projects, and technical wins match Alibaba/Huawei pre-sales work.
Cloud, automation, and AI learning path gives a realistic bridge from current cloud SA experience into deeper platform architecture.
watchouts: Prepare OpenShift/Kubernetes basics and one customer-facing cloud architecture story before applying.
opportunities.resume_angle: Lead with Alibaba/Huawei customer-facing SA work, POC support, demos, and learning agility; frame Intel as data-platform foundation.
opportunities.next_action: Apply first. Tailor cover note around customer discovery, demos, and desire to grow into open-source cloud architecture.

opportunities.title: Junior Solution Architect, Red Hat Enterprise Linux
why_match: Same FASTER early-career program structure; safer level fit than manager or senior architect roles.
Technical sales team and customer account team language aligns with pre-sales solution architect work.
Good platform credibility path: Linux + enterprise architecture + customer-facing solutioning.
watchouts: Need to brush up Linux fundamentals; do not overclaim hands-on admin depth.
opportunities.resume_angle: Position as a cloud vendor SA who wants to deepen infrastructure fundamentals and enterprise open-source solutioning.
opportunities.next_action: Apply after OpenShift or as second Red Hat choice; keep one concise Linux/cloud learning story ready.

opportunities.title: Associate Finance Presales Solution Advisor
opportunities.freshness: Listed recently on JobStreet; SAP Asia-Pacific University page also shows the role in Singapore.
why_match: Very strong Intel bridge: finance data analytics, SAP/SAP HANA, finance accountants, dashboard builders, and Power BI reporting workflows.
Presales cycle, discovery sessions, presentations, demos, proposals, and customer engagement align with Alibaba/Huawei SA work.
Graduate / associate career status is much closer to target level than manager-level AI architect roles.
watchouts: Less AI-heavy; frame it as finance data + enterprise cloud/software presales rather than pure AI/FDE.
opportunities.resume_angle: Lead with Intel finance analytics and SAP/SAP HANA validation, then connect to Huawei/Alibaba pre-sales and demo experience.
opportunities.next_action: Apply with a finance-presales version of the resume and a short note about bridging finance users with technical teams.

opportunities.title: Solution Architect (GenAI), BytePlus
why_match: 3+ year AI/data analytics or solution/pre-sales requirement is closer to current experience than senior manager tracks.
GenAI/data analytics solution strategy, demos, architecture workshops, RFP/RFI, and POC-to-contract motion align with Alibaba Cloud and Huawei Cloud.
Chinese tech vendor context and bilingual communication are strong differentiators.
watchouts: Still more experienced than graduate roles; prepare one GenAI/Qwen POC or demo story.
opportunities.resume_angle: Lead with Alibaba Cloud AI solutioning, Qwen ecosystem exposure, customer discovery, demos, and Intel data analytics platforms.
opportunities.next_action: Apply through official ByteDance login when account access is ready; prepare BytePlus-specific cover note.

opportunities.title: AI Product Solution Architect, BytePlus
why_match: AI product commercialization and overseas GTM match Alibaba Cloud regional solution work.
3+ year requirement is more realistic than manager-level roles.
Pre-sales, technical communication, and product feedback loop fit the current profile.
watchouts: Need to frame GenAI product experience through Alibaba Cloud/Qwen events, demos, and customer conversations.
opportunities.resume_angle: Emphasize Alibaba Cloud AI demos, Qwen ecosystem exposure, regional customer discovery, and bilingual communication.
opportunities.next_action: Apply through official Join ByteDance listing after the GenAI SA application.

opportunities.title: Solutions Architect Graduate (BytePlus) - 2026 Start (BS/MS)
opportunities.role_lane: Graduate AI Solution Architecture / Agentic AI
opportunities.freshness: Official Join ByteDance listing found 2026-06-02; job code A38360B.
why_match: Graduate-level title is aligned with the new target filter and BytePlus is strategically relevant.
Agent solution design, customer requirements, RAG, evaluation, and model API integration connect to AI/FDE direction.
Alibaba/Qwen ecosystem exposure gives a credible vendor-AI parallel.
watchouts: The role is hands-on: Python, LangChain/LlamaIndex, Docker/Kubernetes, and production implementation are called out; coding depth may be the main gap.
opportunities.resume_angle: Frame as AI solution architect / pre-sales with light prototyping exposure; do not overclaim production engineering depth.
opportunities.next_action: Research interview expectations first. Apply only with a simple AI agent demo or project story ready.

opportunities.title: Junior Consultant (Linux, AI, Graduate program)
opportunities.freshness: Official listing checked 2026-06-02; posted recently according to Red Hat Workday.
why_match: Early-career graduate program and customer delivery path are realistic.
Cloud, automation, and AI learning track fits the direction without manager-level expectations.
Customer projects and solution delivery are adjacent to PoC and migration planning work.
watchouts: More delivery/implementation than pre-sales; needs honest Linux and hands-on learning positioning.
opportunities.resume_angle: Position around customer-facing cloud delivery support, POC execution, and fast learning across enterprise platforms.
opportunities.next_action: Research as alternate Red Hat route; apply after the two Junior SA roles if bandwidth allows.

opportunities.title: Professional Services A2C (Associate to Consultant)
opportunities.freshness: Amazon Jobs listing checked 2026-06-02; updated recently according to Amazon search results.
why_match: A2C is explicitly for grads / early-career consultants, so level is right.
Cloud consulting, business acumen, security/data/cloud tracks, and customer projects map to cloud SA trajectory.
Master’s completed July 2025 may fit the completed-within-12-months condition as of June 2026.
watchouts: Listing says candidates must be able to legally work in Singapore. Do not auto-apply until work authorization eligibility is clear.
opportunities.resume_angle: Lead with multi-cloud customer-facing SA work, PoC support, migration planning, and data platform exposure.
opportunities.next_action: Check work authorization question first; apply only if the form permits non-PR/non-citizen applicants legally.

opportunities.title: Product Solution Architect - ModelArk
why_match: Model-as-a-service commercialization, solution presentations, requirement analysis, and product/R&D coordination match Alibaba Cloud AI sales engineering direction.
Qwen/Alibaba Cloud AI exposure supports the enterprise model adoption story.
watchouts: Needs demo/API validation and model product depth; research before applying.
opportunities.resume_angle: Position around MaaS adoption, Qwen/Alibaba AI solution demos, customer requirement analysis, and product feedback loops.
opportunities.next_action: Research first; apply after preparing a short model API / enterprise AI platform talking point.

opportunities.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, BytePlus
why_match: Customer AI transformation roadmap, feasibility, demos, documentation, and solution portfolio work fit the target direction.
Bridge between customer business context and deployable AI solutions is aligned with current SA path.
watchouts: Given coding level is currently 1, this should not be auto-applied until a hands-on demo/prototype story is ready.
opportunities.resume_angle: Frame as customer-facing AI solution architect who can scope demos and roadmaps, while being honest about hands-on depth.
opportunities.next_action: Research only. Build one lightweight AI agent demo before applying.

opportunities.title: Advisory - Consulting, Forensic (Solutions Architect) | Graduate Associate 2026
opportunities.role_lane: Graduate Solutions Architecture / Forensic Data Analytics
opportunities.freshness: Official KPMG listing checked 2026-06-02; applications started 2026-05-09.
why_match: Graduate associate level and data analytics / dashboards are relevant to Intel finance analytics experience.
Systems thinking, integrations, data flows, cloud architecture, Python, SQL, and documentation overlap with technical BA + SA background.
watchouts: This is more full-stack development and troubleshooting than pre-sales; keep behind Red Hat/SAP/BytePlus unless coding confidence improves.
opportunities.resume_angle: Use Intel finance analytics and systems bridge experience; mention Flask/React internship only as supporting evidence.
opportunities.next_action: Research first; apply if willing to take a more hands-on systems/application path.

opportunities.title: AI Deployment Strategist
why_match: Pre-sales discovery, qualification, customer implementation, and post-deployment support map to solution architect work.
FDE-like customer translation role is directionally attractive.
watchouts: Application asks Singapore PR/passport status and likely expects strong hands-on LLM deployment; keep research-first.
opportunities.resume_angle: Lead with customer discovery, AI demos, POC scoping, and bilingual SEA coverage; do not overstate coding depth.
opportunities.next_action: Pause until work authorization and file-upload/applicant-form blockers are clear.

opportunities.title: AI Solution Architect
why_match: Client discovery, proposals, RAG/agent/data platform language aligns with long-term direction.
Useful market signal for future resume development.
watchouts: Manager-level and 5-14 year expectation; not a fit for current early-career target.
opportunities.resume_angle: Keep as future benchmark, not an active application.
opportunities.next_action: Do not auto-apply unless Mark explicitly approves a stretch application.

opportunities.title: Data and AI Solution Architect
opportunities.workplace: Flexible up to 50% remote according to listing

why_match: Intel Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory exposure supports the Azure Data & AI narrative.
Enterprise customer architecture aligns with long-term SA trajectory.
watchouts: Likely expects deeper Microsoft stack and more enterprise architecture maturity than current profile.
opportunities.resume_angle: Use as a future target after building stronger Azure/Fabric/Azure OpenAI proof points.
opportunities.next_action: Do not auto-apply in early-career workflow; monitor only.

opportunities.title: Sales Solution Architect AI/ML
opportunities.role_lane: Data Cloud AI/ML Pre-sales / senior signal
why_match: Snowflake, SQL/Python POCs, AI/ML workloads, discovery, and pre-sales are strategically relevant.
Intel finance analytics gives some credibility with Snowflake/Data Cloud.
watchouts: Often expects around 10+ years and Snowflake-native depth; not aligned with 3-year/early-career filter.
opportunities.resume_angle: Save as future benchmark after strengthening Snowflake and GenAI POC evidence.
